title: Precept Three - Non-Misusing Sex
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett takes up the precept of non-misusing sexuality through Diane Eshin Rizzetto's book Waking Up to What You Do, which phrases it as "I take up the way of engaging in sexual intimacy respectfully and with an open heart." Nomon reads a student's version that meets craving and the fear of craving, closeness and the fear of closeness, and sees this precept drawing on all the others. Along the way come a prayer for survivors of sexual violence, the remark that sex takes eighty years to learn, and a drop in teenage pregnancies from sixty-two per thousand in 1991 to thirteen in 2022. A guided meditation on sexual energy leads into paired sharing, five minutes each, with three sentence starters in the chat.
